fact_text: The video names Nashpa, Tal block, Kadirpur and Uch as OGDC's important fields for predicting its future earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The video names the Sui and Tal blocks as PPL's important fields for predicting its future earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Petroleum policies from 1994, 1997, 2001 and 2012 set the exact price a local oil or gas producer receives, which can differ from international prices and includes windfall levies and price ceilings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Gas bill collections below the cost of gas create a shortfall that flows into circular debt, so part of local producers' revenue stays as receivables rather than cash.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Local gas producers pay a royalty of about 12.5% before operating cost and income tax, so most of the gas sale price is not free profit.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Royalty, operating cost and income tax absorb most of a local gas sale price, leaving a thin profit that any shortfall in receivables can wipe out.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst values these explorers on cash EPS rather than book value, because book value overstates worth while circular debt remains unpaid.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's rule of thumb is to put a multiple of about 4 to 5 times on cash EPS for these companies, reflecting a discount for circular debt.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Investors split into those who price in a newly improved cash EPS at once and those who price realistic current cash EPS; the analyst sides with the second as more realistic.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A plan that clears circular debt through dividends paid to government favours the company where the government holds the larger stake, since the government collects more cash from it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A foreign buyer of a stake may require a producer to clear its prior receivables first, which links any stake sale to circular-debt settlement.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Devaluation raises rupee revenue for USD-priced gas but raises consumer gas costs, which governments are reluctant to pass through, so circular debt grows back.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Devaluation adds macro uncertainty that pulls down market P/E ratios, which hurts explorers' valuations and especially minority shareholders.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC earns a large share of revenue from oil, which the analyst says carries little circular-debt risk because refined fuel is sold for cash at pumps.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Late-payment surcharges on circular-debt receivables can be waived in settlement, so the cash recovered may be well below the amount booked.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: For an old field on a low fixed wellhead price, moving to the latest policy price can roughly double royalty and more than double income tax, so headline price gains may not raise net cash.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC & PPL - Everything you need to know' (YouTube transcript, undated)
